## ParseCookieOptions.expiryDebug property

If `true`<!-- -->, diagnostic information describing how the cookie's expiry was derived is collected and attached to the returned [Cookie](./tough-cookie.cookie.md)<!-- -->. It can be read with [Cookie.getExpiryDebugInfo()](./tough-cookie.cookie.getexpirydebuginfo.md) and serialized to plain JSON for logging.

**Signature:**

```typescript
expiryDebug?: boolean | undefined;
```

## Remarks

- This only affects how the cookie is inspected; it does not change the parsed cookie, its expiry, or any header it is rendered into.

- When parsing standalone (not through `CookieJar.setCookie`<!-- -->), the information is finalized against the local clock at parse time.

Defaults to `false`<!-- -->; when omitted, no diagnostic work is performed.
